classification: Post-failure offline repair; not live validated
observed_defects: The live gap validator interpreted statuses at whole-inventory-entry granularity. Rejected reports described earlier subsets in prose, but the schema had no structured update/time scope.
The prediction query returns measured backend endpoint motion as well as predictions, but the initial read ledger classified it only as a prediction read.
Optional report.gates still exposed duplicate reference and exact numeric fields; both live drafts copied those fields despite using handles for facts.
repairs: InventoryGap now permits explicit update_ids or sampled backend time_range_s. Whole-entry contradictions still reject; unread subsets are compared against execution-derived selected coverage.

Prediction receipts now retain measured endpoint sample times and label the backend-motion and controller fields actually returned. Inventory advertises measured endpoint access through the existing prediction query, including before the final settling window.
Raw controller-page reads retain the selected update ID. Sampled time scopes use actual retained sample timestamps rather than assuming continuous coverage between the first and last query samples.

Native reports express threshold observations as facts with fact_handles; duplicate report.gates fields are removed from the model interface and rejected if supplied. Internal report contracts remain available unchanged.

preservation: No historical source, live raw product, counter, launch guard, frozen schema, or original failure was rewritten. These fixtures do not establish an accepted live report or complete diagnostic workflow.
